Asset credits

Moon

assets/moon.webp is adapted from the full-Moon still in Moon Phase and Libration, 2021, NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio (SVS 4874).

  • Credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio. Visualization by Ernie Wright; produced by David Ladd; scientific consulting by Noah Petro.
  • Project page: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4874/
  • Original image: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a000000/a004800/a004874/phase_full.3492.tif
  • Changes: transparent margin cropped; resized from 3240 × 3240 to 1400 × 1400 pixels; encoded as WebP. The original alpha channel is retained.
  • The SVS states that its content is public domain unless otherwise noted: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/help/#frequently-asked-questions.
  • NASA media guidelines: https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/.

The image is used as decorative lunar imagery, not as an indication of NASA endorsement or a real-time Moon phase.

Social preview

assets/social.jpg is a 1200 × 630 screenshot of the website’s English lunar hero, composed from the credited Moon image, fonts, and original website design. It is a share preview, not a screenshot of the iPhone app.

LunaV screenshots

These images come from the project owner's current local LunaV app previews. They have been resized to 720 × 1565 pixels and encoded as WebP. No app interface or results have been fabricated or composited.

Website asset Original preview
assets/app-camera.webp App/Preview/Voice-Camera.png
assets/app-answer.webp App/Preview/Voice-Inline-Answer.png
assets/app-settings.webp App/Preview/Voice-Settings.png
assets/app-text-sources.webp App/Preview/Text-Sources.png

The camera, answer, and settings previews were captured on 21 October 2026; the text-source preview was captured on 20 October 2026. These show the Simulator interface and OCR examples before the 23 October voice-flow update, not the new hold–talk–release gesture or cancellation states.

The previews are from iOS Simulator. The answer and text-source previews show OCR of a synthetic test fixture. They do not establish live iPhone camera, microphone, visual-model, or LiDAR performance. The camera preview explicitly shows the Simulator test-image state.

Fonts

Fonts are served from this repository; website visitors do not need to request them from Google Fonts or a third-party font CDN.

  • Manrope, variable weight font: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope. Original: Manrope[wght].ttf; converted to assets/fonts/manrope.woff2. SIL Open Font License 1.1 retained in assets/fonts/Manrope-OFL.txt.
  • Noto Sans Thai, variable width/weight font: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosansthai. Original: NotoSansThai[wdth,wght].ttf; converted to assets/fonts/noto-sans-thai.woff2. SIL Open Font License 1.1 retained in assets/fonts/NotoSansThai-OFL.txt.

The NASA imagery and font licenses are separate from the repository's AGPL license. See the files and source links above for their respective terms.
